description: This file defines classes and functions related to a shared memory allocator which interacts with an external shared memory manager process. It includes initialization, managing shared memory regions, and interfacing with the at::RefcountedMapAllocator base class.

classes.name: THManagedMapAllocatorInit
classes.description: Superclass to perform constructor tasks before at::RefcountedMapAllocator is invoked, managing a handle for the shared memory manager.

classes.name: THManagedMapAllocator
classes.description: A specialized shared memory allocator that interacts with an external shared memory manager to ensure proper deallocation of shared memory regions even if processes terminate unexpectedly.

methods.name: libshm_init
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory system with the specified manager executable path.

methods.name: THManagedMapAllocator::close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the shared memory allocator.

methods.name: THManagedMapAllocator::makeDataPtr
methods.description: Creates a DataPtr associated with a shared memory region managed externally.

methods.name: THManagedMapAllocator::fromDataPtr
methods.description: Creates an allocator instance from an existing DataPtr.

methods.name: const char * manager_handle() const
methods.description: Accessor for the handle string associated with the shared memory manager.
